copyright: Sunset over the Damodar River during Chhath Puja (© ParthapratimMukherjee2056/Shutterstock)
description: As the Sun dips towards the horizon, the Damodar River becomes a gathering place for Chhath Puja. The four-day Hindu festival is dedicated to Surya, the Sun God, and Chhathi Maiya. Mainly observed in Bihar, Jharkhand and Uttar Pradesh, as well as parts of Nepal, it is a celebration of gratitude for the Sun and its life-sustaining energy. Devotees observe fasting and gather beside rivers and other bodies of water to pray. One of the festival's most distinctive traditions is offering prayers to both the setting and rising sun, creating striking scenes as families and communities gather at the water's edge at dusk and dawn.

copyright: North Window, Arches National Park, Moab, Utah, USA (© lightphoto/Getty Images)
description: Just north of Moab, Utah, Arches National Park is home to more than 2,000 natural sandstone arches – the densest concentration of arches in the world. Today's image, North Window, is one of the best-known formations in the park's Windows Section, where towering fins, openings and sculpted sandstone create a landscape that looks almost architectural.

copyright: The Atlantic Forest, Brazil (© FG Trade/Getty Images)
description: The Atlantic Forest is one of the world's great biodiversity hotspots, stretching along much of Brazil's Atlantic coast and into Argentina and Paraguay. Its landscape includes tropical and subtropical forests, mangroves and coastal habitats, providing a home for around 20,000 plant species and an extraordinary variety of wildlife, including jaguars and golden lion tamarins. Much of the forest has disappeared over the centuries, but it continues to play an important role in storing carbon and providing fresh water for millions of people across the region.

copyright: Aerial view of Rose Island, The Bahamas (© Abstract Aerial Art/Getty Images)
description: From above, Rose Island looks like a brushstroke of green surrounded by every shade of blue. Just five kilometres east of Paradise Island in The Bahamas, this slender cay trades busy roads and city blocks for sandy shores, shallow waters and an inland lagoon. Its peaceful appearance comes with a touch of movie drama. Rose Island was used as a filming location for the 1965 James Bond adventure 'Thunderball', including the explosive destruction of the Disco Volante.

copyright: Historic district of Triana, Seville, Spain (© Andrzej Rostek/Getty Images)
description: Cross the Guadalquivir River in Seville, the capital of Spain's Andalusia region, and the city's rhythm seems to change. On the other side lies Triana, a colourful neighbourhood where ceramics, flamenco and local traditions are woven into everyday life. Since the 19th century, the Isabel II Bridge, also known as the Triana Bridge, has connected the neighbourhood to Seville's historic centre.

copyright: Lanterns for Diwali in Mumbai, Maharashtra (© Dinodia Photo/Getty Images)
description: Across India, Diwali brings homes, streets and neighbourhoods to life with the warm glow of lanterns, diyas and colourful decorations. Known as the Festival of Lights, it celebrates themes of hope, new beginnings and the triumph of light over darkness. Traditions vary across the country, but for many families, the festivities include creating rangoli, performing Lakshmi Puja, exchanging sweets and gifts, and spending time with loved ones. Diwali is also associated with Lord Rama's return to Ayodhya after defeating Ravana. More than a festival, it's a time for togetherness, reflection and welcoming the year ahead with optimism.

copyright: A bison in the grasslands of Theodore Roosevelt National Park, North Dakota, USA (© Tandem Stock/Adobe Stock)
description: Bison are among the largest land mammals in the world, capable of weighing up to 900 kilograms and reaching speeds of 65 kilometres per hour despite their massive size. Despite often being called a buffalo, the American bison is not one of the true buffaloes, which are native to Africa and Asia. Its scientific name, Bison bison, leaves little room for confusion.
